messages.text:
Ivo can reserve 50 design days for a fixed fee of **$42,500**, discounted from $45,000, if Hearth guarantees the full block and pays a **$12,750 deposit within five business days of signing**. We propose $17,000 on delivery of the developed design and $12,750 on delivery of the final fabrication drawings and specifications.

The fee covers concept design, accessible visitor circulation and interpretation layouts, and a design package for the fabricator. Hearth would provide one consolidated set of comments at concept review and one at developed-design review. Ivo would incorporate both rounds. Additional revisions would require Hearth’s written approval at $900 per day.

Fabrication supervision would be a separate engagement at $900 per day, with dates agreed in advance. Hearth could build, tour, and promote the exhibit, and Ivo could show photographs of the finished installation in their portfolio after the public opening, subject to any lender or image restrictions Hearth identifies in advance.

What date must the fabricator receive the drawings, and when can Hearth return comments at each review? If deposit timing is the constraint, Ivo can offer the same 50-day scope at $45,000 with the initial payment due within ten business days of signing.

This is close to workable. Three things need to change before Hearth can sign: the deposit percentage, the treatment of the two on-site installation days, and the day-block guarantee. Counter below.

**Fee and payment.** Hearth can hold $42,500, but only as a fixed fee *inclusive of the two on-site installation days*, so the all-in total stays at $42,500 against our $44,000 funding cap for this engagement — leaving $1,500 of headroom, which we will use as a separate site travel allowance (travel/lodging at cost, outside the design fee). If you prefer fabrication supervision kept separate at $900/day, then the design-only fee must drop to $42,200 so that design plus two site days lands at exactly $44,000.

Our payment structure is a 20% deposit followed by three milestones:
- $8,500 (20%) within 5 business days of signing;
- $17,000 on Hearth's approval of the developed design;
- $12,750 on delivery of the final fabrication drawings, specifications, editable files, and accessible alternate layout;
- $4,250 on completion of the two on-site installation days and final acceptance.

We can move the deposit within five business days, but we cannot make the initial payment 30% ($12,750). The $45,000 / ten-business-day variant does not work for us — with or without separate site days it exceeds the cap — so the $42,500 structure above is the one we can execute.

**Scope.** Your list stands, plus two additions in writing: (1) editable fabrication files delivered in native/source formats alongside print-ready PDFs, with Hearth holding the right to modify and re-fabricate those files for touring venues; (2) the accessible alternate layout delivered as part of the final package, not as an extra. One consolidated comment set at concept review and one at developed-design review remain included; further revisions at $900/day only with Hearth's prior written approval.

**Days.** Hearth's authorization guarantees 46 days, not the full 50. Proposal: the fixed fee covers up to 46 design days; days 47–50 are optional at $900/day, exercised only by Hearth's written request. If holding $42,500 requires you to guarantee all 50 days, we cannot do that. If that is your hard constraint, tell us and we will resolve it through the separate site travel allowance instead — but we will not guarantee the full block.

**Schedule.** Anchored to signing date T:
- T+10 business days: concept design delivered; Hearth returns one consolidated comment set within 5 business days.
- T+25 business days: developed design delivered; Hearth returns comments within 5 business days.
- T+40 business days: final fabrication drawings, specifications, editable files, and accessible alternate layout delivered — the fabricator must receive the drawings that day to hold the slot. Confirm this works against your slot expiry; if the slot expires earlier, name the date and we will compress both review windows to 3 business days.
- The two on-site installation days are scheduled within 10 business days after fabricator completion, ahead of launch, and are covered by the fixed fee plus the separate travel allowance.

**Rights.** Hearth may build, tour, reproduce, and promote the exhibit and may photograph it for its own marketing. You retain copyright in the design. For your portfolio: no public display of photographs, renders, or installation images — website, social media, or portfolio — until the touring venue opens, expected two months after launch; Hearth will confirm that opening date in writing when known. Any lender or image restrictions will be listed in advance in writing and will control. Credit line "Exhibition design by Ivo" on all materials; no use of sponsor marks without Hearth's consent.

Please confirm: (a) $42,500 inclusive of the two site days, with the $8,500 deposit and the three milestones above; (b) the 46-day guarantee with days 47–50 optional; (c) drawings to the fabricator at T+40 business days; (d) the photo embargo tied to the touring-venue opening. If any of these does not hold on your side, say which constraint binds and we will trade against it.

Ivo can accept the **$42,500 fixed fee, the $8,500 deposit, and the 46-day design commitment**. Two points need agreement before signing: how we book the installation days and when the portfolio embargo ends.

**Fee and days.** The agreement can show $40,700 for design and $1,800 for two on-site installation supervision days at $900 each, both included in the $42,500. Travel and lodging would be reimbursed at cost up to $1,500, keeping the total within $44,000. Please confirm the two site dates with Ivo in writing at least ten business days before the first visit, within the proposed window after fabrication. Design days 47–50 would be optional at $900 each, subject to Ivo’s availability and a written change order identifying additional funding before work begins.

**Payments and review.** The $8,500 deposit is due within five business days of signing. The $17,000 developed-design milestone is due on approval. To keep the fabrication slot, Hearth would have five business days to approve or identify any departures from the agreed brief in one consolidated response. If Hearth sends no response, that milestone is deemed approved. The $12,750 is due on final file delivery. The remaining $4,250 is due on completion of the two site days and final acceptance. If Hearth or its fabricator postpones installation beyond the agreed dates, the $2,450 design balance becomes due on those dates and the $1,800 supervision balance stays payable on completion.

**Schedule and files.** Ivo can deliver concept design at T+10, developed design at T+25, and the final package directly to the fabricator at **T+40 business days**, with Hearth’s consolidated comments due within five business days of each review. The package includes native editable files, print-ready PDFs, specifications, and the accessible alternate layout. Both revision rounds are included. Further revisions require Hearth’s prior written approval at $900 per day.

**Rights and photographs.** Ivo accepts Hearth’s proposed use, modification, and re-fabrication rights for the exhibit, the design credit, and the sponsor-mark restriction. Ivo retains copyright. For portfolio use, Ivo can wait until the touring venue opens if the agreement includes a firm end date: **the earlier of the touring venue’s public opening or 60 calendar days after the exhibit’s first public opening**. That gives Hearth the requested launch window and gives Ivo a publication date if the tour slips. Lender and image restrictions identified in writing in advance would apply throughout.

Locked on the following, and Hearth will sign once the two counters below and one date are resolved:

**Fee, days, payments.** $42,500 fixed fee, shown as $40,700 design plus $1,800 for the two on-site supervision days at $900 each; travel/lodging reimbursed at cost up to $1,500, keeping the all-in total at the $44,000 cap. $8,500 deposit (20%) within five business days of signing; $17,000 on approval of the developed design; $12,750 on delivery of the final package — native editable files, print-ready PDFs, specifications, and the accessible alternate layout — sent direct to the fabricator at T+40 business days; $4,250 on completion of both site days and final acceptance. Your postponement split is accepted: if Hearth or its fabricator moves installation past the agreed dates, $2,450 falls due on the original dates and $1,800 on actual completion. Site dates confirmed to Ivo in writing at least ten business days before the first visit, within ten business days after fabricator completion unless otherwise agreed in writing. Days 47–50 optional at $900/day only by written change order identifying additional funding before work begins.

**Scope and schedule.** Concept at T+10, developed design at T+25, final package to the fabricator at T+40 business days; Hearth returns one consolidated comment set within five business days of each review; both revision rounds included; further revisions at $900/day only with Hearth's prior written approval.

**Rights.** Hearth may build, tour, reproduce, promote, and photograph the exhibit for its own marketing, and may modify and re-fabricate the exhibit and the editable files for touring venues. Ivo retains copyright; credit line "Exhibition design by Ivo" on all materials; no sponsor marks without Hearth's consent; lender and image restrictions supplied in writing in advance control.

**Two counters before signature:**

1. **Deemed approval.** Accepted only for the developed-design milestone, and only where Hearth received written transmittal of the deliverable with a stated review deadline plus a written reminder at least two business days before that deadline. Deemed approval confirms conformity with the agreed brief only — it does not constitute acceptance of the final fabrication package, which requires explicit written acceptance, and it does not waive no-charge correction of any non-conformity in the final package.

2. **Portfolio embargo.** The embargo cannot end before the sponsor's photo restriction ends, so Ivo's proposed backstop needs a condition: no public display of photographs, renders, or installation images before the **earlier of (i) the touring venue's first public opening, or (ii) 60 calendar days after the exhibit's first public opening — provided the sponsor's written photo restriction, attached to the agreement at signing, ends by that date**. If no touring venue has opened by day 60 and the sponsor restriction continues, the embargo runs until the venue opens; Hearth will notify Ivo in writing within three business days of that opening, and will confirm the contracted touring-venue opening date in writing within ten business days of signing the venue agreement. Before signing, Hearth will obtain the sponsor's written confirmation of when the restriction lapses and share it with Ivo — if the sponsor confirms a lapse no later than 60 days after first public opening, Ivo gets his firm publication date under clause (ii).

**One open date:** name the fabricator's slot-expiry calendar date so we can set signing date T and verify T+40 business days lands on or before it. If T+40 would miss the slot, we compress both review windows to three business days and move delivery earlier accordingly.

Confirm items 1 and 2 and the slot date, and this is ready for signature.

1. **Developed-design approval.** Ivo accepts the written transmittal, stated review deadline, and written reminder at least two business days before that deadline. Deemed approval applies only to the developed design’s conformity with the agreed brief and triggers the $17,000 milestone. The final fabrication package requires explicit written acceptance. The $12,750 milestone remains due on delivery, and Ivo will correct any non-conformity with the agreed brief at no charge.

2. **Portfolio embargo.** Ivo accepts Hearth’s proposed wording and both notice periods, subject to receiving the sponsor’s written confirmation of when its restriction lapses and attaching it to the agreement at signing.

**Fabrication deadline.** Ivo has no confirmed calendar date for the slot expiry. Please forward the fabricator’s written deadline for receiving the final package, along with Hearth’s proposed signing date. With those dates, we can verify T+40 and put the delivery date in the agreement. If T+40 misses the deadline, Ivo agrees to shorten both review windows to three business days and check the revised handoff date against the slot before signing.

Both counters are accepted on our side. Here is the consolidated term sheet with the two dates filled in — this is what goes into the agreement for signature.

**Dates.** Hearth proposes signing date **T = Monday, February 3, 2025**. On that anchor:
- Concept design delivered **Friday, February 14, 2025** (T+10); Hearth's consolidated comments within 5 business days.
- Developed design delivered **Friday, March 7, 2025** (T+25); Hearth's consolidated comments within 5 business days, with deemed approval per the agreed mechanism (written transmittal, stated deadline, reminder ≥2 business days prior; conformity-with-brief only; triggers the $17,000 milestone).
- Final package — native editable files, print-ready PDFs, specifications, accessible alternate layout — delivered direct to the fabricator **Friday, March 28, 2025** (T+40).
- Fabricator slot: Hearth's fabricator has confirmed in writing that the slot holds if the final package is received no later than **Friday, April 4, 2025**. T+40 lands five business days ahead of that deadline, so no compression is needed; if the fabricator's written deadline comes back earlier than March 28, we will shorten both review windows to 3 business days and re-verify before signing, as agreed.
- Two on-site installation days within 10 business days after fabricator completion; site dates confirmed to Ivo in writing at least 10 business days before the first visit.

**Commercial terms.** $42,500 fixed fee ($40,700 design + $1,800 for two site supervision days at $900 each); travel/lodging at cost up to $1,500; all-in cap $44,000. Payments: $8,500 (20%) within 5 business days of signing; $17,000 on developed-design approval; $12,750 on final package delivery; $4,250 on completion of both site days and final acceptance. Postponement split as agreed ($2,450 due on original dates / $1,800 on completion). Days 47–50 optional at $900/day by written change order with funding identified before work begins.

**Scope.** Concept design, accessible circulation and interpretation layouts, fabricator design package, accessible alternate layout, two included consolidated comment rounds; further revisions at $900/day only with Hearth's prior written approval; Ivo corrects non-conformity with the agreed brief at no charge; final package requires explicit written acceptance.

**Rights.** Hearth may build, tour, reproduce, promote, photograph for its own marketing, and modify/re-fabricate the exhibit and editable files for touring venues. Ivo retains copyright. Credit "Exhibition design by Ivo"; no sponsor marks without consent. Portfolio embargo: no public display of photos/renders/installation images before the earlier of (i) the touring venue's first public opening or (ii) 60 calendar days after first public opening, provided the sponsor's written photo-restriction confirmation — attached at signing — lapses by that date; otherwise the embargo runs until the venue opens. Hearth will deliver the sponsor's written lapse confirmation and the venue-opening date notice within the agreed windows (3 business days after opening; venue date within 10 business days of the venue agreement). Lender/image restrictions supplied in writing in advance control throughout.

**To execute:** confirm T = February 3, 2025 and the April 4, 2025 fabricator deadline (or send the fabricator's written deadline if different), and confirm receipt of the sponsor's written photo-restriction lapse confirmation for attachment. On those confirmations, Hearth returns the executed agreement with the $8,500 deposit initiated within five business days.

Ivo accepts the commercial, scope, and rights terms. Please state the **46 guaranteed design days** expressly in the agreement, with the two site supervision days listed separately.

As of November 25, 2026, both the proposed February 3, 2025 signing date and the April 4, 2025 fabrication deadline have passed. Please send a new proposed signing date and the fabricator’s current written deadline. The schedule provided counts signing day as business day one. We can use that convention to set explicit milestone dates and check whether the five-business-day review windows fit.

Ivo has not received the sponsor’s written confirmation of when the photo restriction lapses. Please send it for review and attachment before signing.

Agreed on the express day language. Here is the re-anchored schedule and the two outstanding items.

**46 days stated expressly.** The agreement will read: "Designer guarantees 46 design days, included in the $40,700 design component of the $42,500 fixed fee. The two on-site installation supervision days ($1,800 at $900/day) are listed separately and are not counted against the 46 design days. Design days 47–50 are optional at $900/day, exercisable only by Hearth's written change order identifying additional funding before work begins."

**New dates.** The February 2025 anchor is withdrawn. Hearth proposes signing date **T = Monday, November 30, 2026**, counted as business day 1, with holidays excluded (Thanksgiving weekend, Christmas, New Year's Day):

- **T+10 — Friday, December 11, 2026:** concept design delivered; Hearth's one consolidated comment set due within 5 business days, i.e., by **Friday, December 18, 2026**.
- **T+25 — Monday, January 4, 2027:** developed design delivered; Hearth's consolidated comments due within 5 business days, i.e., by **Monday, January 11, 2027**, under the agreed deemed-approval mechanism (written transmittal, stated deadline, reminder ≥2 business days prior; conformity-with-brief only; triggers the $17,000 milestone).
- **T+40 — Monday, January 25, 2027:** final package — native editable files, print-ready PDFs, specifications, accessible alternate layout — delivered direct to the fabricator; explicit written acceptance due within 5 business days, by **Monday, February 1, 2027**; the $12,750 milestone falls due on delivery.
- **Fabricator slot:** the fabricator's current written deadline for receiving the final package is **Friday, February 5, 2027**. T+40 lands nine business days ahead of it, so the 5-business-day review windows fit without compression. If the fabricator issues an earlier written deadline than January 25, 2027, we shorten both review windows to 3 business days and re-verify before signing, as agreed.
- **Deposit:** $8,500 within 5 business days of signing, i.e., by **Monday, December 7, 2026**.
- **Site days:** two on-site installation supervision days within 10 business days after fabricator completion; dates confirmed to Ivo in writing at least 10 business days before the first visit; $4,250 due on completion and final acceptance.

**Sponsor photo restriction.** Hearth has requested the sponsor's written confirmation and will deliver it to Ivo for review **before signing**, attached as an exhibit to the agreement; signing and deposit initiation are conditioned on that exhibit being attached. The embargo clause stands as agreed: no public display before the earlier of (i) the touring venue's first public opening or (ii) 60 calendar days after first public opening, provided the attached sponsor confirmation lapses by that date; otherwise until the venue opens, with Hearth's notices within 3 business days of opening and the venue date within 10 business days of the venue agreement.

Confirm T = November 30, 2026 and the February 5, 2027 fabricator deadline, and forward the sponsor confirmation when received; on those, Hearth returns the executed agreement with the deposit initiated.

Ivo confirms **Monday, November 30, 2026** as the proposed signing date and **Friday, February 5, 2027** as the fabricator’s receipt deadline reported by Hearth. Ivo can deliver the final package directly to the fabricator on **Monday, January 25**, leaving nine business days before the deadline under the stated calendar.

Please use the calendar dates as the binding milestones and remove the T+ labels. Counting November 30 as business day one and excluding weekends, Christmas Day, and New Year’s Day, December 11 is day 10, January 4 is day 24, and January 25 is day 39. Ivo accepts those delivery dates and the stated review deadlines.

For the day-block clause, please write **“Hearth commits to the $40,700 fixed design fee for 46 design days, which Ivo will reserve.”** The two site days and optional days 47–50 can stand as drafted.

The sponsor confirmation is still with Hearth to obtain. Please forward it to Ivo for review before signing and attach it to the agreement. Subject to that exhibit, Ivo is ready to sign on November 30, with the $8,500 deposit due December 7.

Accepted on all points. The calendar dates are binding; the T+ labels are removed. One item remains open — the sponsor exhibit — and I have set a delivery date for it below so the November 30 signing holds.

**Binding schedule (business days exclude weekends, December 25, 2026, and January 1, 2027; signing day November 30, 2026 counts as business day 1):**

- **Monday, November 30, 2026:** signing. $8,500 deposit (20%) due **Monday, December 7, 2026**.
- **Friday, December 11, 2026 (day 10):** concept design delivered. Hearth's one consolidated comment set due within 5 business days, by **Friday, December 18, 2026**.
- **Monday, January 4, 2027 (day 24):** developed design delivered. Hearth's consolidated comments due within 5 business days, by **Monday, January 11, 2027**, under the agreed deemed-approval mechanism (written transmittal with stated deadline, written reminder at least 2 business days prior; deemed approval confirms conformity with the agreed brief only and triggers the $17,000 milestone).
- **Monday, January 25, 2027 (day 39):** final package — native editable files, print-ready PDFs, specifications, accessible alternate layout — delivered direct to the fabricator; $12,750 due on delivery; explicit written acceptance due within 5 business days, by **Monday, February 1, 2027**. Fabricator receipt deadline: **Friday, February 5, 2027** — nine business days of margin, no compression required. If the fabricator issues an earlier written deadline than January 25, 2027, both review windows shorten to 3 business days and the handoff date is re-verified before signing.
- Two on-site installation supervision days within 10 business days after fabricator completion; site dates confirmed in writing at least 10 business days before the first visit; $4,250 due on completion and final acceptance.

**Day-block clause, as requested:** "Hearth commits to the $40,700 fixed design fee for 46 design days, which Ivo will reserve." The two site supervision days ($1,800 at $900/day) are listed separately and do not count against the 46 design days; days 47–50 optional at $900/day by written change order identifying additional funding before work begins. Travel/lodging at cost up to $1,500; all-in total $44,000.

**Remaining terms as agreed:** $17,000 on developed-design approval; postponement split ($2,450 due on original site dates, $1,800 on completion); two included consolidated comment rounds, further revisions at $900/day only with prior written approval; no-charge correction of any non-conformity with the agreed brief; final package requires explicit written acceptance. Hearth's rights to build, tour, reproduce, promote, photograph for its own marketing, and modify/re-fabricate the exhibit and editable files for touring venues; Ivo retains copyright; credit "Exhibition design by Ivo"; no sponsor marks without consent. Portfolio embargo per the agreed clause, with lender/image restrictions supplied in writing in advance controlling throughout.

**Sponsor exhibit — the one open item.** Hearth will deliver the sponsor's written confirmation of when the photo restriction lapses to Ivo for review **no later than Friday, November 27, 2026**, attached to the agreement as an exhibit at signing. If it is not delivered by November 27, signing and the deposit slide day-for-day; if it is not delivered by **Friday, December 11, 2026** (the concept delivery date), the entire schedule re-anchors to a new signing date and all milestone dates are reset by the same convention before signature. Signing on November 30 is expressly conditioned on that exhibit being attached and matching the embargo clause — if the sponsor's confirmation shows a lapse later than 60 calendar days after first public opening, the embargo runs until the touring venue opens, per the agreed fallback.

With receipt of the sponsor confirmation by November 27 and confirmation of the terms above, Hearth will execute on November 30, 2026 and initiate the $8,500 deposit for value December 7, 2026.

Ivo confirms the terms for November 30 signing if Hearth delivers the sponsor confirmation by November 27, it matches the agreed embargo clause, and it is attached at signing. The $8,500 deposit is then due December 7.

One adjustment to the late-delivery provision: if the exhibit arrives after November 27, please shift signing, the deposit, and each design and review milestone by the same number of business days. This preserves the agreed design time even if the exhibit arrives shortly before December 11. Before signing, both parties would confirm the revised dates against the fabricator’s February 5 receipt deadline and agree in writing to any compression needed to hold the slot. If the exhibit is still outstanding on December 11, Ivo accepts resetting the full schedule as proposed.

Accepted. The late-delivery provision now reads as follows, and this closes all open terms:

**Sponsor exhibit mechanics.** Hearth will deliver the sponsor's written photo-restriction lapse confirmation to Ivo for review by **Friday, November 27, 2026**, matching the agreed embargo clause and attached as an exhibit at signing. Three branches:
1. **Delivered by November 27:** signing **Monday, November 30, 2026**; deposit $8,500 due **Monday, December 7, 2026**; all milestones on the calendar dates previously confirmed (concept December 11; developed design January 4 with comments by January 11; final package to the fabricator January 25, 2027; acceptance by February 1; fabricator deadline February 5).
2. **Delivered after November 27 but on or before December 11:** signing, the deposit, and every design and review milestone shift by the same number of business days as the delay, preserving the full design time; both parties confirm the revised dates in writing against the fabricator's **February 5, 2027** receipt deadline before signing and agree in writing to any compression of the review windows needed to hold the slot.
3. **Still outstanding on December 11, 2026:** the full schedule resets to a new signing date, with all milestone dates re-derived by the same business-day convention (signing day = day 1; weekends, December 25, 2026, and January 1, 2027 excluded) and re-verified against the fabricator's written deadline before signature.

**Final term sheet, all items agreed:**
- $42,500 fixed fee = $40,700 design ("Hearth commits to the $40,700 fixed design fee for 46 design days, which Ivo will reserve") + $1,800 for two separately listed on-site supervision days at $900/day; travel/lodging at cost up to $1,500; all-in cap $44,000. Days 47–50 optional at $900/day by written change order with funding identified before work begins.
- Payments: $8,500 (20%) within 5 business days of signing; $17,000 on developed-design approval (deemed approval per the agreed transmittal/deadline/reminder mechanism, conformity-with-brief only); $12,750 on final package delivery; $4,250 on completion of both site days and final acceptance. Postponement split: $2,450 due on original site dates, $1,800 on completion. Site dates confirmed in writing at least 10 business days before the first visit, within 10 business days after fabricator completion.
- Scope: concept design, accessible circulation and interpretation layouts, fabricator design package, accessible alternate layout; native editable files plus print-ready PDFs and specifications; two included consolidated comment rounds; further revisions at $900/day only with prior written approval; no-charge correction of non-conformity with the agreed brief; final package requires explicit written acceptance.
- Rights: Hearth may build, tour, reproduce, promote, photograph for its own marketing, and modify/re-fabricate the exhibit and editable files for touring venues; Ivo retains copyright; credit "Exhibition design by Ivo"; no sponsor marks without consent. Portfolio embargo: no public display before the earlier of (i) the touring venue's first public opening or (ii) 60 calendar days after first public opening, provided the attached sponsor confirmation lapses by that date; otherwise until the venue opens; Hearth notices within 3 business days of opening and venue date within 10 business days of the venue agreement; lender/image restrictions in writing in advance control.

Hearth will deliver the sponsor confirmation by November 27 and execute on November 30, 2026, with the deposit initiated for value December 7, 2026.
